UX surfaceBoot surfaces: what the user sees first on each bundle.

Members

CornerBrackets

Public wasm surface — one bracket canvas per button.

frame

frame — repack the uniform block, draw the brackets.

  • @param _dt Frame delta — unused (the shader is stateless:
  • @returns false once the surface is stale/lost.
  • @param {number} _dt
  • @returns {boolean}

init

init — device + pipeline + uniform bind group.

  • @param canvas The overlay canvas (the button's own box).
  • @param device The shared GPUDevice (one per page, from the JS bridge).
  • @returns Ok on a live surface, Err(JsValue) on failure.
  • @param {HTMLCanvasElement} canvas
  • @param {GPUDevice} device

constructor

CornerBrackets::new — un-initialized widget; init must follow.

resize

resize — device px — the res uniform.

  • @param w @param h Backing size in device pixels.
  • @param {number} w
  • @param {number} h

set_arms

set_arms — push the stub/full arm lengths and hairline (all device px — JS computes them from the rect + tokens once).

  • @param a0w @param a0h Stub arm lengths.
  • @param a1w @param a1h Full arm lengths.
  • @param hair Hairline half-width in device px.
  • @param {number} a0w
  • @param {number} a0h
  • @param {number} a1w
  • @param {number} a1h
  • @param {number} hair

set_colors

set_colors — push the resting/hover colors (computed style read once per theme flip — the shader never sees CSS vars).

  • @param er @param eg @param eb @param ea Resting rgba 0-1.
  • @param ar @param ag @param ab @param aa Hover rgba 0-1.
  • @param {number} er
  • @param {number} eg
  • @param {number} eb
  • @param {number} ea
  • @param {number} ar
  • @param {number} ag
  • @param {number} ab
  • @param {number} aa

set_hover

set_hover — drive the eased hover progress (JS runs the ease so the shader stays stateless; pump frames while the value is moving, settle it to present the last frame).

  • @param v Eased progress 0..1 (0 = stub arms, 1 = full span).
  • @param {number} v

set_size

set_size — CSS px (contract parity; unused — device px only).

  • @param _w @param _h CSS size — unused.
  • @param {number} _w
  • @param {number} _h
